```{r setup, include=FALSE}
options(future.globals.maxSize = 96000 * 1024^2)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  message = FALSE,
  echo = TRUE
)
```

```{r deps}
# set up params
species <- params$species
gid <- params$gid
mergedObj <- params$mergedObj
resolution <- as.numeric(strsplit(params$resolution_list, ",")[[1]])
npcs <- as.numeric(params$npcs)
vars_to_regress <- params$vars_to_regress
vars_to_regress_list <- if (is.null(vars_to_regress) || toupper(vars_to_regress) == "NULL") {
  NULL
} else {
  unlist(strsplit(gsub(" ", "", vars_to_regress), ","))
}
celldex_cache <- params$celldex_cache

source(params$scRNA_functions)
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(SingleR)
library(rliger)

options(future.globals.maxSize = 96000 * 1024^2)
```

```{r processing}
# read in merged object
so <- readRDS(mergedObj)

# assign assay
DefaultAssay(so) <- "RNA"
so[["RNA"]] <- as(so[["RNA"]], Class = "Assay5")
if ("counts" %in% Layers(so)) {
  so[["RNA"]] <- split(so[["RNA"]], f = so$Sample)
}
#set reduction name based on version of rliger
reduction_label <- "inmfNorm"
if(packageVersion("rliger") < "2.0"){
  reduction_label <- "iNMF"
}

# integrate
so_corrected <- MAIN_BATCH_CORRECTION(so, npcs, species, resolution,
  method_in = "LIGER", reduction_in = reduction_label,
  v_list = vars_to_regress_list, cache_path = celldex_cache
)
```

```{r save-outputs, include=FALSE}
fpath <- paste0(gid, "_batch_correction_liger.rds")
saveRDS(so_corrected, fpath)
```
